_comment: Copy to ~/.reelmimic/secrets.json (outside the repo). Every key is optional.
FFMPEG_DIR: folder containing ffmpeg/ffprobe if they are not on PATH
CODEX_BIN: path to a specific codex CLI if an old one shadows it on PATH
MAX_AGENTS: agents running at once across all projects (default 10)
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: a Discord channel webhook: get a message when a video needs you or is done (video attached)
WEBHOOK_URL: any URL that should get a JSON POST on the same events
REELMIMIC_URL: base of the links in those messages (default http://localhost:4318)
